title: Agent discipline: detect-signal-route, not detect-fix
body: When agents identify an issue or optimization opportunity, the impulse is to fix it immediately. Required behavior: capture → signal → route. Do NOT implement in place. This applies to: framework protocol improvements, cross-spoke behavior changes, optimization ideas surfaced during a session. The fix-impulse is a scope violation — it mutates framework outside of formal adoption. Historian should watch track entries for the anti-pattern 'agent identified X and immediately implemented Y' and surface it for tuning. Work tracking must go into lugs (signal/task/epic/idea) — not TaskCreate, scratch .md files, or in-memory notes. These don't survive session ends and are invisible to wakeup.
